fields.statement: At a33575de (attempt 2), docs/concepts/change-sets.md covers intention and record, the draft-to-landed lifecycle with reject/withdraw, the append-only log, carving, reopening and rendering. Attempt 1's finding is fixed: the carve example now reads `rhiza carve access-roles --from <source-id> --to <target-id> --with-children`, which matches `rhiza carve --help` (--from/--to take an ID or a 4+ character prefix). docs-links-resolve: `go test -trimpath ./internal/doclinks/...` ok. docs-commands-exist: the check is not in the tree at this commit, so I checked by hand. With a scratch build, `--help` succeeds for every command the doc names: change new/use/show/ls, propose, accept, land, reject, withdraw, link, log, carve, reopen, render, check and ready. --change is a global flag. The discovered-from link type exists. The prose reads plainly, with no AI tells. The owner's read is still to come.
